winner.text: Add goku and Vegeta fighting with octopus

decision_note: Built as an homage rather than the trademarked characters: two original rival fighters, Sonny and Prinz, who live in town as residents (simple short hair, no aura day to day) and, rarely, fly off to fight Gåmson. The fight is shot like a film (letterbox bars, a title card, a camera that frames the action, hit-stops, slow motion, synthesised sound effects and battle music): they land, trade insults and power up; a different run of moves each time (combos, both rushing him, charged beams, his swats and ink, the two fighting each other); a stray beam smashes his rock and sends his loot home; Tåhgong comes to the rescue (the squid stays, as the creator asked); they bow and fly off. The cube can join in and earn a charm.
